statements.quote: This increase primarily reflects investments in artificial intelligence.
statements.notes: 'This increase' is the $59.3 billion year-over-year increase in purchases of property and equipment over the trailing twelve months ended March 31, 2026. That is a change in total capex, not an AI amount, so it is recorded as qualitative with scope total and no figure. The sentence names no year, and the trailing twelve months span parts of 2025 and 2026. The $59.3 billion is not usable as a quote because the sentence stating it is cut off at the start of p01.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses (R&D, infrastructure costs, headcount) to AI. The p02 AI-chip deployment counts describe capacity, not spend.
